# Retention policy

## 4. Retention periods

4.1 Customer records are kept for 2 years after the account closes.

4.2 Contractor records are kept for 1 year after the contract ends.

4.3 Staff records are kept for 6 years after employment ends.

4.4 Supplier records are kept for 6 years after the contract ends.

## 5. Review

5.1 This policy is reviewed every two years.
